title: Initial assignment check
caption: The saved initial all-or-nothing assignment has relative gap 0, against the unchanged 0.0001 stopping threshold. No Frank–Wolfe updates were needed. This does not imply uncongested roads. Reported zero is drawn at 1e-12 on the log axis; it is not a positive measured gap.
transformation: One actual saved iteration-0 observation. Log floor only when reported gap is zero; original numeric value retained in plot data.
